author: Kushal
problem: titles lists the albums in a record shop. Return them in shelf order: alphabetical, but ignoring a leading word 'The', so 'The Wall' is filed under W.
bug_description: Checks startswith('The') without the space, so titles that merely begin with those letters ('Theory', 'Theatre Royal') are filed by their fifth character onwards.

comments.accurate: Sorts titles alphabetically, ignoring a leading 'The'
comments.wrong_behavior: Sorts titles alphabetically, skipping the first four characters of any title that begins with 'The'
comments.wrong_location: Prefix check verified; the sort is case-sensitive, so lowercase titles may file last
